# googleworkspace_org_unit (Resource)

Manages a Google Workspace organizational unit via the Admin SDK Directory API.

Changing `parent_org_unit_path` replaces the organizational unit.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "googleworkspace_org_unit" "engineering" {
  name                 = "Engineering"
  parent_org_unit_path = "/"
  description          = "Engineering organization"
}

resource "googleworkspace_org_unit" "platform" {
  name                 = "Platform"
  parent_org_unit_path = googleworkspace_org_unit.engineering.org_unit_path
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String)
- `parent_org_unit_path` (String)

### Optional

- `description` (String)

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The unique ID of this resource.
- `org_unit_path` (String)

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# The import ID is the organizational unit ID, optionally prefixed with "id:".
# The org unit path is not accepted.
terraform import googleworkspace_org_unit.engineering 03ph8a2z1abcdef

terraform import googleworkspace_org_unit.engineering id:03ph8a2z1abcdef
```
